local tty = require("tty")
local client = require("client")
local channel = require("channel")
local process = require("process")
local time = require("time")
local uuid = require("uuid")
local funcs = require("funcs")
local appearance = require("appearance")
local json = require("json")

local READ_AFTER = "bee.threads.service:read_after"
local WATCH = "bee.threads.delivery:watch"
local RESET = "\27[0m"

local fn_inst = funcs.new()

type ReadAfterReply = {
    records: {unknown},
    scanned_through: integer,
    has_more: boolean,
}

local function validate_read_after(val: unknown): ReadAfterReply?
    if type(val) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local raw_records = val.records
    if type(raw_records) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local records: {unknown} = {}
    for i, r in ipairs(raw_records) do
        records[i] = r
    end
    local st = val.scanned_through
    local scanned: integer = 0
    if type(st) == "number" and st == st and st >= 0 and st <= 9007199254740992 then
        scanned = math.floor(st)
    end
    local hm = val.has_more == true
    return {
        records = records,
        scanned_through = scanned,
        has_more = hm,
    }
end

type Measurement = {
    schema: string,
    benchmark: string,
    label: string,
    source_sha256: string,
    units: string,
    samples: {number},
    iterations: integer,
    corpus_size: integer,
    checksum: integer,
    correct: boolean,
    outcome: string,
    correctness_error: string?,
}

type Measurements = {
    baseline: Measurement?,
    candidate: Measurement?,
}

type State = {
    thread_id: string,
    cursor: integer,
    measurements: Measurements,
    baseline_seq: integer,
    candidate_seq: integer,
    status: string,
}

local function is_valid_int(val: unknown): boolean
    if type(val) ~= "number" then return false end
    if val ~= val or val == math.huge or val == -math.huge then return false end
    if val < 0 or val > 9007199254740992 or val ~= math.floor(val) then return false end
    return true
end

local function validate_raw_measurement(data: unknown): Measurement?
    if type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
    if data.schema ~= "bee.research.measurement@1" then return nil end
    if data.benchmark ~= "canonical-json@1" then return nil end
    local label = data.label
    if label ~= "baseline" and label ~= "candidate" then return nil end
    local sha = data.source_sha256
    if type(sha) ~= "string" or #sha ~= 64 or not sha:match("^[0-9a-f]+$") then return nil end
    if data.units ~= "ns/op" then return nil end

    local raw_samples = data.samples
    if type(raw_samples) ~= "table" or #raw_samples ~= 7 then return nil end
    local count = 0
    for k, _ in pairs(raw_samples) do
        if type(k) ~= "number" or k < 1 or k > 7 or k ~= math.floor(k) then
            return nil
        end
        count = count + 1
    end
    if count ~= 7 then return nil end

    local samples: {number} = {}
    for i = 1, 7 do
        local s = raw_samples[i]
        if type(s) ~= "number" or s <= 0 or s ~= s or s == math.huge or s == -math.huge then
            return nil
        end
        samples[i] = s
    end

    local iter = data.iterations
    if type(iter) ~= "number" or iter <= 0 or iter ~= math.floor(iter) or iter > 9007199254740992 then return nil end
    local corpus = data.corpus_size
    if type(corpus) ~= "number" or corpus <= 0 or corpus ~= math.floor(corpus) or corpus > 9007199254740992 then return nil end
    local chk = data.checksum
    if type(chk) ~= "number" or chk <= 0 or chk ~= math.floor(chk) or chk > 9007199254740992 then return nil end

    local correct = data.correct
    if type(correct) ~= "boolean" then return nil end
    local outcome = data.outcome
    if type(outcome) ~= "string" then return nil end
    if correct and outcome ~= "passed" then return nil end
    if not correct and outcome ~= "invalid" then return nil end

    local raw_err = data.correctness_error
    local err_text: string? = nil
    if raw_err ~= nil then
        if type(raw_err) ~= "string" or #raw_err == 0 or #raw_err > 512 or raw_err:find("%c") then
            return nil
        end
        err_text = raw_err
    end

    local m: Measurement = {
        schema = "bee.research.measurement@1",
        benchmark = "canonical-json@1",
        label = label,
        source_sha256 = sha,
        units = "ns/op",
        samples = samples,
        iterations = math.floor(iter),
        corpus_size = math.floor(corpus),
        checksum = math.floor(chk),
        correct = correct,
        outcome = outcome,
        correctness_error = err_text,
    }
    return m
end

local function parse_measurement(record: unknown): Measurement?
    if type(record) ~= "table" then return nil end
    if record.kind ~= "observation" or record.source ~= "mcp"
        or record.producer_id ~= "bee.research.measurement" then return nil end
    local body = record.body
    if type(body) ~= "table" or body.type ~= "extension" then return nil end
    local content = body.data
    if type(content) ~= "table" or content.type ~= "extension"
        or content.event_name ~= "bee.research.measurement" or content.event_revision ~= "1" then return nil end
    local raw_text = content.payload_json
    if type(raw_text) ~= "string" or #raw_text == 0 or #raw_text > 16384 then return nil end
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, raw_text)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
    return validate_raw_measurement(data)
end

local function validate_checkpoint(resume_raw: unknown, explicit_thread: string?): (boolean, string, integer, integer, integer, Measurement?, Measurement?)
    if type(resume_raw) ~= "string" or #resume_raw == 0 or #resume_raw > 65536 then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, resume_raw)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end

    if data.schema ~= "bee.research.dashboard@2" then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    local th = data.thread_id
    if type(th) ~= "string" or #th == 0 or #th > 160 or th:find("%c") then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    if explicit_thread ~= nil and th ~= explicit_thread then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end

    local raw_cursor = data.cursor
    if raw_cursor == nil then
        raw_cursor = data.after_sequence
    end
    if not is_valid_int(raw_cursor) then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    local cursor = math.floor(raw_cursor)

    local raw_base_seq = data.baseline_seq
    if not is_valid_int(raw_base_seq) then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    local base_seq = math.floor(raw_base_seq)
    if base_seq > cursor then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end

    local raw_cand_seq = data.candidate_seq
    if not is_valid_int(raw_cand_seq) then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    local cand_seq = math.floor(raw_cand_seq)
    if cand_seq > cursor then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end

    local base_m: Measurement? = nil
    if data.baseline ~= nil then
        local m = validate_raw_measurement(data.baseline)
        if not m or m.label ~= "baseline" then
            return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
        end
        base_m = m
    end

    local cand_m: Measurement? = nil
    if data.candidate ~= nil then
        local m = validate_raw_measurement(data.candidate)
        if not m or m.label ~= "candidate" then
            return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
        end
        cand_m = m
    end

    if (base_m == nil and base_seq ~= 0) or (base_m ~= nil and base_seq == 0)
        or (cand_m == nil and cand_seq ~= 0) or (cand_m ~= nil and cand_seq == 0) then
        return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    if type(th) ~= "string" then return false, "", 0, 0, 0, nil, nil end
    return true, th, cursor, base_seq, cand_seq, base_m, cand_m
end

local function serialize_checkpoint(state: State): string
    local base_data = nil
    if state.measurements.baseline then
        local b = state.measurements.baseline
        base_data = {
            schema = b.schema,
            benchmark = b.benchmark,
            label = b.label,
            source_sha256 = b.source_sha256,
            units = b.units,
            samples = b.samples,
            iterations = b.iterations,
            corpus_size = b.corpus_size,
            checksum = b.checksum,
            correct = b.correct,
            outcome = b.outcome,
            correctness_error = b.correctness_error,
        }
    end
    local cand_data = nil
    if state.measurements.candidate then
        local c = state.measurements.candidate
        cand_data = {
            schema = c.schema,
            benchmark = c.benchmark,
            label = c.label,
            source_sha256 = c.source_sha256,
            units = c.units,
            samples = c.samples,
            iterations = c.iterations,
            corpus_size = c.corpus_size,
            checksum = c.checksum,
            correct = c.correct,
            outcome = c.outcome,
            correctness_error = c.correctness_error,
        }
    end
    local payload = {
        schema = "bee.research.dashboard@2",
        thread_id = state.thread_id,
        cursor = state.cursor,
        after_sequence = state.cursor,
        baseline_seq = state.baseline_seq,
        candidate_seq = state.candidate_seq,
        baseline = base_data,
        candidate = cand_data,
    }
    local ok, encoded = pcall(json.encode, payload)
    if ok and type(encoded) == "string" then
        return encoded
    end
    return "{}"
end

local function median(values: {number}): number
    local count = #values
    if count == 0 then return 0 end
    local copy: {number} = {}
    for i, v in ipairs(values) do
        copy[i] = v
    end
    table.sort(copy)
    if count % 2 == 1 then
        local mid = math.ceil(count / 2)
        local val = copy[mid]
        if val then return val end
        return 0
    else
        local idx1 = math.floor(count / 2)
        local idx2 = idx1 + 1
        local val1 = copy[idx1]
        local val2 = copy[idx2]
        if val1 and val2 then
            return (val1 + val2) / 2
        elseif val1 then
            return val1
        elseif val2 then
            return val2
        end
        return 0
    end
end

local function draw_frame(width: integer, height: integer, preferences: appearance.Preferences, state: State): {string}
    local theme = appearance.theme(preferences.theme)
    local canvas = tty.canvas(width, height)
    canvas:clear(appearance.style(theme.text, theme.surface) .. " " .. RESET)

    local function put(x: integer, y: integer, value: string, size: integer, fg: string?, bg: string?)
        if y >= 1 and y <= height and x >= 1 and size > 0 then
            canvas:put(x, y, appearance.style(fg or theme.text, bg or theme.surface) .. value .. RESET, size)
        end
    end

    local function line(y: integer, value: string, fg: string?, bg: string?)
        if y < 1 or y > height then return end
        put(1, y, string.rep(" ", width), width, fg, bg)
        local max_len: integer = 0
        if width > 2 then
            max_len = width - 2
        end
        local trunc = tty.text.truncate(value, max_len, "…")
        put(2, y, trunc, tty.text.width(trunc), fg, bg)
    end

    line(1, "PERFORMANCE RESEARCH · canonical-json@1", theme.accent)
    local header2 = string.format("Thread: %s  ·  Cursor: %d",
        state.thread_id, state.cursor)
    line(2, header2, theme.muted)
    local sep_width: integer = 0
    if width > 2 then
        sep_width = width - 2
    end
    line(3, string.rep("─", sep_width), theme.border)

    local base = state.measurements.baseline
    local cand = state.measurements.candidate

    if not base and not cand then
        line(5, "Waiting for canonical-json@1 measurements…", theme.text)
        line(6, string.format("Listening on thread '%s'", state.thread_id), theme.muted)
        line(7, "No measurements have arrived yet. Durable records will appear automatically.", theme.muted)
    else
        local base_med = 0
        if base then
            base_med = median(base.samples)
        end
        local cand_med = 0
        if cand then
            cand_med = median(cand.samples)
        end
        local max_med = math.max(base_med, cand_med)
        if max_med <= 0 then max_med = 1 end

        local raw_cols = width - 44
        local bar_max_cols: integer = 8
        if raw_cols > 28 then
            bar_max_cols = 28
        elseif raw_cols > 8 then
            bar_max_cols = raw_cols
        end

        local y: integer = 5
        line(y, "BENCHMARK COMPARISON", theme.accent)
        y = y + 1

        if base then
            local b_len: integer = 1
            if base_med > 0 and max_med > 0 then
                local calc: integer = math.floor((base_med / max_med) * bar_max_cols)
                if calc > bar_max_cols then
                    b_len = bar_max_cols
                elseif calc > 1 then
                    b_len = calc
                end
            end
            local b_bar = string.rep("█", b_len) .. string.rep("░", bar_max_cols - b_len)
            local b_status = base.correct and "CORRECT" or "INVALID"
            local b_txt = string.format("baseline  %s · %.1f %s", b_status, base_med / 1.0, base.units)
            line(y, b_txt, theme.text)
            y = y + 1
            line(y, b_bar, theme.muted)
        else
            line(y, "baseline   [waiting for data…]", theme.muted)
        end
        y = y + 1

        if cand then
            local c_len: integer = 1
            if cand_med > 0 and max_med > 0 then
                local calc: integer = math.floor((cand_med / max_med) * bar_max_cols)
                if calc > bar_max_cols then
                    c_len = bar_max_cols
                elseif calc > 1 then
                    c_len = calc
                end
            end
            local c_bar = string.rep("█", c_len) .. string.rep("░", bar_max_cols - c_len)
            local c_status = cand.correct and "CORRECT" or "INVALID"
            local c_txt = string.format("candidate %s · %.1f %s", c_status, cand_med / 1.0, cand.units)
            line(y, c_txt, theme.text)
            y = y + 1
            line(y, c_bar, theme.muted)
        else
            line(y, "candidate  [waiting for data…]", theme.muted)
        end
        y = y + 1

        if base and cand and base_med > 0 and cand_med > 0 then
            local diff_pct = ((cand_med - base_med) / base_med) * 100
            local speedup = base_med / cand_med
            local comp_text
            if base.correct and cand.correct then
                if cand_med <= base_med then
                    comp_text = string.format("Improvement: %.1f%% faster (%.2fx speedup)", -diff_pct, speedup)
                else
                    comp_text = string.format("Regression: +%.1f%% slower (%.2fx slower)", diff_pct, 1 / speedup)
                end
            else
                local timing_str
                if cand_med <= base_med then
                    timing_str = string.format("%.1f%% faster (%.2fx speedup)", -diff_pct, speedup)
                else
                    timing_str = string.format("+%.1f%% slower (%.2fx slower)", diff_pct, 1 / speedup)
                end
                comp_text = string.format("Comparison: unqualified/invalid (%s)", timing_str)
            end
            line(y, comp_text, theme.accent)
            y = y + 1
        end

        y = y + 1
        line(y, string.rep("─", sep_width), theme.border)
        y = y + 1

        line(y, "MEASUREMENT DETAILS", theme.accent)
        y = y + 1

        local function render_details(m: Measurement?, label_name: string)
            if not m then
                line(y, string.format("• %s: Not yet received", label_name), theme.muted)
                y = y + 1
                return
            end
            local med = median(m.samples)
            local samples_str: {string} = {}
            for i, s in ipairs(m.samples) do
                samples_str[i] = string.format("%.1f", s / 1.0)
            end
            line(y, string.format("• %s: %s (outcome: %s)", label_name, m.correct and "PASSED" or "FAILED", m.outcome), m.correct and theme.text or theme.accent)
            y = y + 1
            if m.correctness_error then
                line(y, string.format("  Error: %s", m.correctness_error), theme.accent)
                y = y + 1
            end
            line(y, string.format("  Digest:   %s", m.source_sha256), theme.muted)
            y = y + 1
            line(y, string.format("  Median:   %.1f %s  (#samples: %d, iters: %d, corpus: %d, chk: %d)",
                med / 1.0, m.units, #m.samples, m.iterations, m.corpus_size, m.checksum), theme.muted)
            y = y + 1
            if #samples_str > 0 then
                line(y, string.format("  Samples:  [%s]", table.concat(samples_str, ", ")), theme.muted)
                y = y + 1
            end
        end

        if y <= height - 6 then
            render_details(base, "Baseline")
        end
        if y <= height - 3 then
            render_details(cand, "Candidate")
        end
    end

    local help = "R refresh · Esc/Q quit"
    if state.status ~= "" then
        help = state.status .. " · " .. help
    end
    line(height, help, theme.muted)

    return canvas:rows()
end

local function main(value: unknown)
    local launch = client.launch(value)
    if not launch then error("Invalid application launch") end
    local broker = launch.broker_pid
    local requested = launch.arguments[1]
    if #launch.arguments > 1 then error("Expected an optional thread id") end

    local explicit_thread: string? = nil
    if requested ~= nil then
        if type(requested) ~= "string" or requested == "" or #requested > 160 or requested:find("%c") then
            error("Invalid thread id")
        end
        explicit_thread = requested
    end
    local target_thread = explicit_thread or "research-performance"

    local input = assert(tty.events())
    local lifecycle = assert(process.events())
    local states = assert(process.listen("bee.appearance.state", {message = true}))
    assert(tty.start())
    local output = assert(tty.surface())
    local width, height = tty.screen_size()
    local preferences = appearance.defaults()

    local state: State = {
        thread_id = target_thread,
        cursor = 0,
        measurements = {
            baseline = nil,
            candidate = nil,
        },
        baseline_seq = 0,
        candidate_seq = 0,
        status = "",
    }

    local valid_cp, cp_th, cp_cur, cp_b_seq, cp_c_seq, cp_b, cp_c = validate_checkpoint(launch.resume_state, explicit_thread)
    if valid_cp then
        state.thread_id = cp_th
        state.cursor = cp_cur
        state.baseline_seq = cp_b_seq
        state.candidate_seq = cp_c_seq
        state.measurements.baseline = cp_b
        state.measurements.candidate = cp_c
    else
        state.thread_id = target_thread
        state.cursor = 0
        state.baseline_seq = 0
        state.candidate_seq = 0
        state.measurements.baseline = nil
        state.measurements.candidate = nil
    end

    local waiting = nil
    local wait_channel = nil
    local reading = nil
    local read_channel = nil

    local function cancel_wait()
        if waiting then waiting:cancel() end
        waiting = nil
        wait_channel = nil
    end

    local function cancel_read()
        if reading then reading:cancel() end
        reading = nil
        read_channel = nil
    end

    local function arm_wait()
        cancel_wait()
        if reading then return end
        local fut, err = fn_inst:async(WATCH, {
            thread_id = state.thread_id,
            after_sequence = state.cursor,
            wait_ms = 30000,
            transport_budget_ms = 5000,
        })
        if fut and not err then
            waiting = fut
            wait_channel = fut:response()
        end
    end

    local function request_read()
        if reading then return end
        cancel_wait()
        local fut, err = fn_inst:async(READ_AFTER, {
            thread_id = state.thread_id,
            cursor = state.cursor,
            limit = 64,
        })
        if fut and not err then
            reading = fut
            read_channel = fut:response()
        end
    end

    if broker then
        process.send(broker, "bee.appearance.request", {version = 1, request_id = uuid.v7(), op = "state"})
    end

    local rows = draw_frame(width, height, preferences, state)
    assert(output:present(rows, {cursor = {x = 1, y = 1, visible = false}}))
    client.ready(launch)

    local last_checkpoint = serialize_checkpoint(state)
    client.checkpoint(launch, last_checkpoint)

    request_read()

    local running = true
    local dirty = false
    local ticker = assert(time.ticker("5s"))
    local ticks = ticker:channel()

    while running do
        if dirty then
            local r = draw_frame(width, height, preferences, state)
            assert(output:present(r, {cursor = {x = 1, y = 1, visible = false}}))
            local cp = serialize_checkpoint(state)
            if cp ~= last_checkpoint then
                if client.checkpoint(launch, cp) then
                    last_checkpoint = cp
                end
            end
            dirty = false
        end

        local cases = {
            input:case_receive(),
            lifecycle:case_receive(),
            states:case_receive(),
            ticks:case_receive(),
        }
        if read_channel then
            cases[#cases + 1] = read_channel:case_receive()
        end
        if wait_channel then
            cases[#cases + 1] = wait_channel:case_receive()
        end

        local event = channel.select(cases)
        if not event.ok then break end

        if event.channel == lifecycle then
            if event.value.kind == process.event.CANCEL then
                running = false
            end
        elseif read_channel and event.channel == read_channel then
            local fut = reading
            reading = nil
            read_channel = nil
            local has_more = false
            local valid_page = false
            if fut then
                local res, err = fut:result()
                if res and not err then
                    local data = res:data()
                    if type(data) == "table" and data.ok == true then
                        data = data.value
                    end
                    local page = validate_read_after(data)
                    if page then
                        valid_page = true
                        state.status = ""
                        for _, rec in ipairs(page.records) do
                            if type(rec) == "table" and type(rec.sequence) == "number" then
                                local seq: integer = math.floor(rec.sequence)
                                if seq > state.cursor then
                                    state.cursor = seq
                                end
                                local m = parse_measurement(rec)
                                if m then
                                    if m.label == "baseline" then
                                        if seq >= state.baseline_seq then
                                            state.measurements.baseline = m
                                            state.baseline_seq = seq
                                        end
                                    elseif m.label == "candidate" then
                                        if seq >= state.candidate_seq then
                                            state.measurements.candidate = m
                                            state.candidate_seq = seq
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if page.scanned_through > state.cursor then
                            state.cursor = page.scanned_through
                        end
                        has_more = page.has_more
                    end
                end
            end
            if has_more then
                request_read()
            elseif valid_page then
                arm_wait()
            else
                state.status = "Thread unavailable; retrying"
            end
            dirty = true
        elseif wait_channel and event.channel == wait_channel then
            local fut = waiting
            waiting = nil
            wait_channel = nil
            local watch_ok = false
            if fut then
                local result, result_error = fut:result()
                if result and not result_error then
                    local reply = result:data()
                    watch_ok = type(reply) == "table" and reply.ok == true
                end
            end
            if watch_ok then
                request_read()
            else
                state.status = "Thread unavailable; retrying"
            end
            dirty = true
        elseif event.channel == ticks then
            if not reading and not waiting then
                request_read()
            end
            dirty = true
        elseif event.channel == states then
            local message = event.value
            if broker and message:from() == broker then
                local payload = message:payload():data()
                local next_pref = appearance.decode(payload)
                if next_pref and type(payload) == "table" and payload.version == 1 then
                    preferences = next_pref
                    dirty = true
                end
            end
        else
            local data = event.value
            if data.type == "close" then
                running = false
            elseif data.type == "resize" then
                width = data.width
                height = data.height
                dirty = true
            elseif data.type == "key" and data.action ~= "release" then
                local pressed = data.key_type
                local letter = tostring(data.key or "")
                if pressed == "esc" or pressed == "escape" or letter == "q" then
                    running = false
                elseif letter == "r" then
                    request_read()
                    dirty = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    cancel_read()
    cancel_wait()
    ticker:stop()
    process.unlisten(states)
    output:close()
    tty.stop()
end

return {main = main}

-- MIT. Canonical JSON for plain Lua values: sorted keys, no whitespace, so
-- equal requests and replies compare byte for byte. Dense integer-keyed
-- tables encode as arrays; an empty table encodes as an empty object.
local M = {}
local MAX_DEPTH = 32

local ESCAPES: {[string]: string} = {}
ESCAPES['"'] = '\\"'
ESCAPES['\\'] = '\\\\'
ESCAPES[string.char(0)] = "\\u0000"
ESCAPES[string.char(1)] = "\\u0001"
ESCAPES[string.char(2)] = "\\u0002"
ESCAPES[string.char(3)] = "\\u0003"
ESCAPES[string.char(4)] = "\\u0004"
ESCAPES[string.char(5)] = "\\u0005"
ESCAPES[string.char(6)] = "\\u0006"
ESCAPES[string.char(7)] = "\\u0007"
ESCAPES[string.char(8)] = "\\u0008"
ESCAPES[string.char(9)] = "\\u0009"
ESCAPES[string.char(10)] = "\\u000a"
ESCAPES[string.char(11)] = "\\u000b"
ESCAPES[string.char(12)] = "\\u000c"
ESCAPES[string.char(13)] = "\\u000d"
ESCAPES[string.char(14)] = "\\u000e"
ESCAPES[string.char(15)] = "\\u000f"
ESCAPES[string.char(16)] = "\\u0010"
ESCAPES[string.char(17)] = "\\u0011"
ESCAPES[string.char(18)] = "\\u0012"
ESCAPES[string.char(19)] = "\\u0013"
ESCAPES[string.char(20)] = "\\u0014"
ESCAPES[string.char(21)] = "\\u0015"
ESCAPES[string.char(22)] = "\\u0016"
ESCAPES[string.char(23)] = "\\u0017"
ESCAPES[string.char(24)] = "\\u0018"
ESCAPES[string.char(25)] = "\\u0019"
ESCAPES[string.char(26)] = "\\u001a"
ESCAPES[string.char(27)] = "\\u001b"
ESCAPES[string.char(28)] = "\\u001c"
ESCAPES[string.char(29)] = "\\u001d"
ESCAPES[string.char(30)] = "\\u001e"
ESCAPES[string.char(31)] = "\\u001f"
ESCAPES[string.char(127)] = "\\u007f"

local function encode_string(value: string): string
    if not value:find('[%c"\\\\]') then
        return '"' .. value .. '"'
    end
    local escaped = value:gsub('[%c"\\\\]', ESCAPES)
    return '"' .. escaped .. '"'
end

local function encode_value(value: unknown, depth: integer): (string?, string?)
    if depth > MAX_DEPTH then return nil, "value nests deeper than 32" end
    if value == nil then return "null", nil end
    if type(value) == "boolean" then return value and "true" or "false", nil end
    if type(value) == "number" then
        if value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then return nil, "number is not finite" end
        if value == math.floor(value) and math.abs(value) <= 9007199254740992 then return string.format("%d", math.floor(value)), nil end
        return string.format("%.17g", value + 0.0), nil
    end
    if type(value) == "string" then return encode_string(value), nil end
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return nil, "value is not encodable" end
    if next(value) == nil then return "{}", nil end

    local count = 0
    local keys: {string} = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do
        count = count + 1
        local t = type(key)
        if t == "string" then
            keys[#keys + 1] = key
        elseif t ~= "number" or key ~= math.floor(key) or key < 1 then
            return nil, "table key is not encodable"
        end
    end
    if #keys > 0 and #keys ~= count then return nil, "table mixes list and object keys" end
    if #keys == 0 and count > 0 then
        local parts: {string} = {}
        for index = 1, count do
            local item: unknown = value[index]
            if item == nil then return nil, "list is not dense" end
            local encoded, encode_error = encode_value(item, depth + 1)
            if not encoded then return nil, encode_error end
            parts[index] = encoded
        end
        return "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]", nil
    end
    if #keys > 1 then table.sort(keys) end
    local parts: {string} = {}
    for index, key in ipairs(keys) do
        local encoded, encode_error = encode_value(value[key], depth + 1)
        if not encoded then return nil, encode_error end
        parts[index] = encode_string(key) .. ":" .. encoded
    end
    return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}", nil
end

function M.encode(value: unknown): (string?, string?)
    return encode_value(value, 1)
end

return M
